analysis.title: Tau × amyloid microglia study
analysis.summary: Mouse 2×2 design: MAPTKI, P301S, NLGF_MAPTKI, NLGF_P301S. Three assays: snRNA-seq pseudobulk, GeoMx spatial, bulk TiO2 proteomics + phosphoproteomics.
analysis.source: Hand-written prototype fixture. Structure + wording are drawn from veriformatics studies/naoto docs (CONTRACT.md, PROOF_SCOPE.md, case-study.md, publication-review, annotation-audit-findings). No data. Statuses reflect those docs, not a live check.

questions.text: Does mutant humanized tau (P301S) change the microglial response to amyloid (NLGF)?
Do the assays and measurement layers agree on the amyloid response?
Which phosphoproteomic results can be published?
Is there a tau- or amyloid-modulated proliferative microglia state?

experiments.title: Check that no animal appears in two assays
experiments.method: Resolve every assay-local sample ID through the animal registry, aliases and exclusions included. A proved checker confirms that each specimen resolves to one animal and one genotype, and that the three assays share no animal.
experiments.caveat: Missing or unresolved IDs are inconclusive. A shared animal permits pairing for confirmed matched specimens only; group-level comparison stays valid.

experiments.title: Verify the gene-ID mapping against a pinned Ensembl release
experiments.method: Pin the Ensembl annotation used for snRNA quantification and the GeoMx target manifest. Define a policy for version suffixes, retired IDs, aliases and many-to-one mappings. A proved checker confirms every retained mapping follows that policy and flags ambiguous entries.
experiments.needs: symbol_map + source annotation + GeoMx panel manifest + mapping policy
experiments.caveat: The result holds for these source annotations and the approved policy. Ambiguity is inconclusive; a confirmed wrong mapping is a failure.

experiments.title: Audit phosphosite-to-protein-group assignments
experiments.method: Pin the search database, protein-group membership and site-localization records. Check each peptide sequence, modified residue and group membership, and list every compatible group. Accept only assignments that the grouping policy justifies uniquely.
experiments.needs: Search-engine output + search FASTA + localization scores
experiments.caveat: Sequence compatibility cannot prove the biological parent protein, so success supports a premise only. Ambiguous peptides stay open; a confirmed incompatible assignment is a failure.

experiments.title: Refit the two contrasts without MAPTKI samples
experiments.method: Create a separate refit from raw inputs for P301S, NLGF_MAPTKI and NLGF_P301S only. Recompute filtering, normalization, missing values and moderation without MAPTKI, with a limma workflow for intensities (voom takes counts). A proved dataflow checker confirms that no MAPTKI value enters any step.
experiments.caveat: The refit is a new analysis with its own estimates and fewer degrees of freedom. It does not verify the existing four-group outputs.

experiments.title: Trace both proteomics tables to their raw instrument files
experiments.method: Trace each protein-group and phosphosite table through raw acquisition IDs, fractions and processing records. A proved checker confirms that no protein-group value is aggregated or derived from the restricted phosphosite values.
experiments.needs: Raw-file and fraction manifest + processing lineage
experiments.caveat: A separate measurement does not give permission to publish. The data owner must still rule on the restriction scope (O22). Shared TiO2 enrichment alone does not show dependence.

experiments.title: Run model diagnostics on the snRNA pseudobulk fits
experiments.method: Inspect the voom mean-variance trend, residual patterns, leverage, outliers and the eBayes prior fit. Rerun key estimates under prespecified alternative weights and moderation, and record how the effect sizes change.
experiments.needs: Pseudobulk counts + fitted design + sample metadata
experiments.caveat: Diagnostics support model assumptions; they cannot prove them, so success adopts a premise. A warning or an underpowered screen is inconclusive. Only a confirmed violation, such as unmodeled repeated preparations, falsifies O6.

experiments.title: Specify the FDR family and prove the reported tables follow it
experiments.method: Approve a versioned family manifest: the complete tested feature set per contrast and the adjustment method. A proved checker confirms the complete p-value vectors, adjusted values and reported tables follow that manifest.
experiments.needs: Complete p-value vectors + result tables + reviewed family manifest
experiments.caveat: This verifies the approved family contract, not that per-contrast FDR is the right scientific choice. A proof that does not complete is inconclusive.

experiments.title: Verify a bounded limma/voom numerical path
experiments.method: Freeze the versions, input domain and executed path. Specify error bounds through weights, fitting, moderation and tail probabilities. Audit one component against a high-precision oracle first, then prove that the executed path refines the contract.
experiments.caveat: Months is a lower bound. Oracle agreement is test evidence only; only a completed refinement proof verifies O4. The trusted base grows to include the floating-point model and the R runtime.

experiments.title: Replicate in a cohort balanced for sex and batch
experiments.method: Plan a new cohort from a power calculation for the interaction. Put both sexes of every genotype in every preparation batch, balance age, litter and cage, and blind processing. Repeat snRNA-seq and report estimates with intervals.
experiments.caveat: The new cohort gets its own facts; the existing data keep their confound. Support for a causal genotype effect stays a premise, not a proof. A null or underpowered result does not falsify the effect.

experiments.title: Sample microglia away from plaques in GeoMx
experiments.method: Define the target population first. Sample plaque-contact and plaque-distant regions in all genotypes by a prespecified stratified scheme, with purity controls and population weights. Compare assay effects on prespecified shared genes.
experiments.caveat: New regions cannot make the original plaque-selected population equal to all snRNA microglia. A scientist must rule that the weighted regions represent all microglia; that ruling stays a premise.

experiments.title: Acquire an unrestricted, balanced phosphoproteomics cohort
experiments.method: First ask the owner whether the existing results can be released. If not, agree on publication terms and collect all four genotypes in shared preparation and acquisition batches. A proved dataflow checker confirms no restricted value enters any step.
experiments.needs: Data agreement + new animals + mass spectrometry
experiments.caveat: A new MAPTKI group alone would confound genotype with cohort, so the cohort must include all four genotypes. Permission and provenance stay separate conditions.

experiments.title: Check which contrasts the existing design can estimate
experiments.method: Tabulate genotype by sex by preparation batch. A proved checker computes the design rank and confirms whether each genotype contrast is estimable with sex and batch as nuisance terms.
experiments.caveat: Sex aliased with batch prevents separating sex from batch, but genotype can still be estimable. Success corrects the recorded violation; it does not show the effect is causal.

experiments.title: Stain for cycling microglia
experiments.method: Co-stain microglia with Iba1, Ki67 and an EdU pulse in all four genotypes, with positive cycling controls. Quantify blinded, per animal, and compare with the cluster-2 signature.
experiments.needs: Tissue sections or new animals + EdU dosing
experiments.caveat: Staining can show a cycling population; it cannot prove cluster 2 is that population, so success adopts a premise. A stain without working positive controls is inconclusive.

claims.text: The interaction contrast measures how P301S tau changes the amyloid response.

claims.question: Q1
claims.text: P301S tau amplifies the microglial transcriptional response to amyloid (interaction FDR < 0.05, snRNA pseudobulk).

claims.question: Q1
claims.text: Mutant tau causes microglia to fail to respond to amyloid plaques.

claims.question: Q2
claims.text: Amyloid responses of plaque-contacting microglia (GeoMx) match those of all snRNA microglia.

claims.question: Q2
claims.text: At group level, nlgf_in_p301s effect directions agree between snRNA and GeoMx for shared genes.

claims.question: Q2
claims.text: Each contrast compares genotype groups within one assay; no animal is paired across assays.

claims.question: Q2
claims.text: For P301S and NLGF lines, phosphosite changes can be normalized to parent-protein changes within the same animals, separating phosphorylation from protein abundance.

claims.question: Q3
claims.text: Phosphosite results for tau_alone, nlgf_in_maptki and interaction can be published.

claims.question: Q3
claims.text: Phosphosite results for nlgf_in_p301s and tau_in_nlgf can be published.

claims.question: Q3
claims.text: Protein-group proteomics results are not covered by the phosphosite restriction.

claims.question: Q4
claims.text: A proliferative microglia population is depleted in NLGF_P301S mice.

claims.question: Q4
claims.text: Cluster 2 makes up 0.87–4.27% of each NLGF_P301S preparation and 58.80–67.72% of three MAPTKI preparations.
